name: – Nacho Sánchez Amor – After § 35 – Am 36
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Türkiye
part_text: 35a. Acknowledges that Türkiye continues to host a large migrant and refugee population; emphasises that refugee protection and reception in the region should remain the primary response to migratory pressures; insists, however, that this responsibility must not be used by the Turkish Government to weaponise migration or to extract financial concessions from the EU; stresses that cooperation on migration must be based on the prevention of irregular migration towards the EU;
